content: SvelteKit 2 file upload via form actions: form uses enctype='multipart/form-data' and use:enhance. Server action reads: const data = await request.formData(); const file = data.get('photo') as File; const bytes = await file.arrayBuffer(); const buffer = Buffer.from(bytes). Then pass buffer to boto3 upload_fileobj via the FastAPI endpoint. FastAPI side: async def upload_photo(file: UploadFile = File(...)): content = await file.read(); validate content type against ['image/jpeg','image/png','image/webp']; validate size; process. python-multipart is already included in fastapi[standard] — no additional install needed.
